title: Elephants Can Hear With Their Feet
description:
They can't jump, they eat for most of the day, and they pick up rumbles through the ground with their feet.

#shorts #animalfacts #elephant #wildlife

scenes.text: Elephants can hear through their feet.
They pick up low rumbles travelling through the ground, sometimes from other elephants far away.
Their trunk has around forty thousand muscle bundles, strong enough to lift a log and gentle enough to pick up a peanut.
An adult elephant can't jump. Not even a little.
And they can spend up to sixteen hours a day just eating.
Which elephant fact surprised you? Tell me in the comments.
